description.p: Database Manager is a desktop client to open, browse, query, edit, export (CSV) and back up databases across five engines from one UI: SQLite (incl. SQLCipher-encrypted files), MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and LMDB.
It offers a plain-English row finder for non-technical users plus a raw SQL / command editor for developers, password-protected database support, and one-click backups.
